definitions.explanation: The final part of a word, especially the part that changes during conjugation or inflection. Also refers to the trailing tone or intonation at the end of a spoken phrase.

examples.japanese: ⟦{動詞|どうし}→動詞：03472_doushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{語尾|ごび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変化|へんか}する→変化する：20997_henkasuru⟧。
{語尾|ごび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{質問|しつもん}→質問：00888_shitsumon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}こえる→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
examples.english: If you raise the ending, it sounds like a question.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{語尾|ごび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変|か}える→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧で、⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧さ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{度合|どあ}い→度合い：12456_doai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: In Japanese, just changing the word ending greatly changes the level of politeness.

notes:
{語尾|ごび} is a compound of ⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧ (word) and ⟦{尾|び}→尾：18068_bi⟧ (tail). It refers to the ending or final portion of a word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {語尾|ごび}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変化|へんか}する→変化する：20997_henkasuru⟧ (the ending changes)
- {語尾|ごび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (raise the ending intonation)
- {語尾|ごび}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伸|の}ばす→伸ばす：01973_nobasu⟧ (stretch out the ending)

In grammar discussions, {語尾|ごび} refers to inflectional endings that change during conjugation (e.g., the ending of a verb that changes between dictionary form and past tense). In spoken language, it can also refer to the intonation or trailing sound at the end of a sentence, such as the rising tone that marks a question.
